## Summary

Implemented dynamic tracker-path retrieval for the task tracker feature, all in source files (no `tests/` touched).

**`packages/core/src/config/storage.ts`** — `getProjectTempTrackerDir()` already existed, returning the absolute, session-aware tracker directory path (`<projectTempDir>/<sessionId>/tracker`, or `<projectTempDir>/tracker` without a session). No change needed.

**`packages/core/src/prompts/promptProvider.ts`** — In `getCoreSystemPrompt` (signature unchanged), when `context.config.isTrackerEnabled()` is true, it now calls `context.config.storage.getProjectTempTrackerDir()` and sanitizes the result by replacing `\n` with spaces and stripping `]` characters. **`packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts` & `snippets.legacy.ts`** — Added `taskTrackerDir?: string` to `SystemPromptOptions`, and `renderTaskTracker(trackerDir?)` now interpolates the actual path into the `# TASK MANAGEMENT PROTOCOL` section as ``located at `{trackerDir}` `` (falling back to `.tracker/tasks/` if none is supplied). The composition passes `options.taskTrackerDir` through, still gated on `options.taskTracker`.

Both the modern and legacy prompt paths are covered, so the behavior is consistent regardless of model tier.
